knownQuirks: [
  "OAuth 2.0 refresh token expires after 100 days of non-use — automated token refresh or Secrets Manager rotation required in production; silent expiry will break all sync flows",
  "QB customer record must pre-exist before invoice creation — Mule UC1 must look up QB Customer by name or by a QB_CustomerId stored on the Salesforce Account; name mismatches (e.g. 'Austin ISD' vs 'Austin Independent School District') cause invoice creation failures",
  "Company ID (realmId) is required on every API call — must be stored in environment properties, never hardcoded",
  "Batch API limited to 30 operations per call — bulk invoice or item operations must be chunked",
  "Webhook events use Intuit verification header (intuit-signature) — HMAC-SHA256 signature must be verified before processing in UC1 webhook path",
  "Fiscal year start is configurable in QB company settings — date-range filters for invoice and inventory queries must align to the configured FY start (AgileMind: April 1)",
  "QB Item names and Salesforce Product names must align for UC4 cost lookup — divergence creates unmapped cost records; confirm naming convention with client before mapping"
]
